effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying the cost. (Digimon/Cost 14/Lv.6/White/Mega/Unknown/Unidentified/3000 DP)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is played, you may activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects.
[All Turns] All of your other Digimon with [Diaboromon] in their names gain ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
